title: Add literal complete-row caller for the two-role parking boundary
body:
The retained parking-boundary verifier routed nested payloads with host slicing and zip. This package replaces that seam for W=2 complete runtime-width rows with a fixed eight-port, four-symbol split/call/rejoin machine, reusing the existing row Builder, parking controller and extracted transfer tables.

For positive B,R and V=2RB, both actual child calls receive V/2 bits. The written conditional proof charges every guide reset, park/restore, erase and head return: wrapper cost 44V+32R+107 <= 60V+107, plus the two named child costs. Retained backing is counted relative to entry K0, including erased prefixes, guide, source/output and ancestor parking. The 73/78 instruction routers are independent of sizes and payloads.

Scope: one completed caller under explicit child semantic/frame/locality/uniform-resource contracts, with a supplied unary descriptor. This is not a global fixed-tape recursive scheduler, descriptor-conversion theorem or multiplication supplier. Those obligations remain open.

Validation: registered Python 3.12 normal/-O replay passes 218 fixtures and 10 controls; independent mixed-child review and exact proof/code hash review pass. Committed-byte/source-history preflight, official 19-file export integrity and Git-free cold replay pass; cold source drift is rejected and restored bytes are unchanged. No Lean/kernel proof run or selected-result change. Review found and fixed a simulator default step cap before publication. Independent review is agent review, not human or kernel acceptance.

Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Retains commdata2338 parking-controller attribution, JoyboyBrian R8 Builder credit and original Lean source notices.
